milestones.title: One complete web journey
milestones.goal: Enter a topic, generate an Instagram Story, copy it or request a reviewed edit.
tasks: Implemented: Create screen, writing treatment and fixed Story destination
Implemented: existing pipeline adapter and final-artifact delivery checks
Implemented: private sign-in, durable history, idempotency and daily admission limit
Implemented: edit, clarification and failed-topic suggestion continuations
Pending: owner live generation and deployed smoke checks

milestones.title: Every creator has their own voice
milestones.goal: Each creator confirms a private voice profile built from their supplied examples.
tasks: Account identity and profile ownership
Collect examples and explicit dislikes
Confirm and version the voice summary
Use the same profile in writer, editor, reviewer and adviser
Verify isolation, deletion and restart persistence

milestones.title: Recover from the actual problem
milestones.goal: Repair appropriate failures within a clear budget, with independent review.
tasks: Calibrate review against human judgments
Handle repairable voice and format uncertainty
Validate research evidence, dates and source applicability
Exercise credit, fallback and budget outcomes
Preserve Opus for failed-topic advice only

milestones.title: Prepare a dependable hosted release
milestones.goal: Make the web app safe and observable before opening it to independent testers.
tasks: Deploy frontend on Vercel with a same-origin backend route
Deploy the generation backend with durable storage
Add multi-user authorization, quotas and retention controls
Validate job recovery, polling identity and safe errors
Verify rollback and deployed commit

milestones.title: Prove quality with people
milestones.goal: Evaluate at least 60 cases across supported routes and distinct voices.
tasks: Add Reel and Post after the Story journey passes
Run the reported failure examples and provider regressions
Measure technical completion, human voice ratings, latency and cost
Target 95% technical completion and 80% human ratings at 4/5 or better
Resolve high-severity issues before beta

milestones.title: Seven-day invited beta
milestones.goal: Invite 5–10 creators, collect feedback and fix recurring causes before expanding.
tasks: Prepare onboarding and daily quotas
Collect voice, structure and usefulness feedback
Review incidents and costs daily
Add regression evidence for each recurring failure
Decide whether release gates justify broader access
